title: Treasury liquidity-support buyback operation (20-30Y nominal, 1:40pm ET)
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Buyback Operations (August 2026 Quarterly Refunding, masthead `For Publication August 5, 2026`), PDF text layer decompressed direct 2026-09-05 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 125,547 bytes) — the row reads verbatim announce 10/26/2026, operation 10/27/2026 1:40 pm - 2:00 pm, settle 10/28/2026, Liquidity Support, Nominal Coupons 20Y to 30Y, maturity range 10/28/2046 - 10/27/2056, min $0, max $2 billion. Stays estimate on three counts: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, its $2B cap is SUPERSEDED by press release sb0607 (see notes), and the confirming primary is the 10-26 operation announcement rather than this document, checked 2026-09-05
notes: Lands 40 minutes after treasury-5y-note-2026-10-27 closes on the SAME afternoon (auction 1:00pm ET, buyback 1:40pm ET) and settles on fomc-2026-10-28’s decision day — so that session carries a belly sale and a long-end bid inside the same 40 minutes, which is exactly why an afternoon curve move on 10-27 is not attributable to either alone. THE PUBLISHED $2B CAP ON THIS ROW IS STALE AND SHOULD NOT BE QUOTED: press release sb0607 (2026-08-19) doubles the 10-20Y and 20-30Y liquidity-support minimum to at least $4B per operation, effective 2026-09-09 and in effect `for the remainder of this refunding quarter (through November 4, 2026)`, which covers this operation; the schedule PDF fetched 2026-09-05 is unrevised (masthead still reads August 5) and treasury-buyback-10y20y-2026-10-15 records the same staleness independently. The sector is 20-30Y NOMINAL, not the belly — the 5-year note sold that morning is nowhere near the 10/28/2046 - 10/27/2056 range, and TreasuryDirect’s buyback FAQ excludes on-the-run securities in any case (see treasury-buyback-20y30y-2026-09-24’s notes). Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed, and a $0-4B liquidity-support operation is a demand-side mechanic rather than a price signal. Discovered during the treasury-5y-note-2026-10-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05); the 10-21 TIPS 1Y-10Y operation on the same schedule is six days out, outside this event’s five-day corridor, and is deliberately left unfiled — exactly the handoff treasury-buyback-10y20y-2026-10-15’s notes anticipated.
